description: Stage 4b dedicated cases: block body statements, the takeover path (StatementBuilder.CollectBodyStatements + EnableBlockBodyCatalog) and the two defects fixed in r2 (D1 first-statement pos, D2 last statement closed before `}`). With the shipped default (EnableBlockBodyCatalog=true) each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape shell leaks into the shape tree. The takeover counters and the no-fallback expectation are asserted by tests/statement-possible/block-body-takeover.mjs; the measured evidence is recorded in HANDOFF-s4b-r2.md.

stage4b.stage: Stage 4b (block body statements taken over by possible)
stage4b.description: Block body takeover: mixed let/expression body, two calls, nested block, in-block ASI, two blocks in a row, mixed body, uncovered control flow inside a block (legacy/raw, no fallback), empty statement inside a block, three expression statements, last statement without a semicolon before `}` (D2), first-statement pos (D1), comments at the head and tail of a block body, control-flow families inside a block.
